comparison.objective: Measure a 5 ml medicine dose using the dosing cup; candidate finishes installed threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Selecting and filling a calibrated vessel versus bimanual mandrel stabilization, hammer striking, and millimetre-scale fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: A 5 ml dose in the proper tool versus four contact-loaded fractures, complete containment, and undamaged retained hardware. Detailed dose tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Liquid measurement and tool selection are unrelated to controlled notch fracture.
